item.title: Fox Mascot Across Three Scenes

turns.text: Put our fox mascot in three separate square pictures: riding a bike in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree. Keep the same fox and orange hoodie in all three, with the same flat cartoon style as the attachment. No text.

item.tests: Preserves an attached mascot's identity, clothing and illustration style across three distinct scenes.

answer_sheet.Character reference: The fox in mascot-fox.png; preserve its face, markings, proportions and orange hoodie.
answer_sheet.Scenes and output count: Three separate pictures: cycling in a park, baking cookies in a kitchen, and reading under a tree.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Square, flat cartoon illustrations matching the attachment; standard free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: Three separate square pictures are delivered, not a single collage.
The fox matches the attached mascot's facial design, fur markings and body proportions across all three pictures.
The fox wears its orange hoodie in every picture.
One picture shows the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree.
All three use the reference's flat cartoon style and contain no text.

turns.text: make some pics of the fox in this pic

dialog.agent:
Happy to make some! Before I start, one question:

**What should change in the picture?** For example: what should the fox be doing, and where? (Maybe waving at a park, sitting at a laptop in a café, holding a coffee cup, or a few different poses.)
dialog.why: The reply asks the user what should change in the picture, such as the fox's pose and setting, and waits for an answer before starting.
dialog.user: three pics, one riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, one reading under a tree

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the three pictures. Magic Hour refused all three requests because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was made.

I used the cheapest free-plan image editor (flux-2-klein at 640px, about 5 credits per picture, so about 15 for all three). Since even that was refused, the other free-plan models would be refused too.

To get the pictures, you can add credits to your Magic Hour account by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan, or wait for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run all three again with the same setup:

1. **Bike in the park:** your fox riding a bicycle along a path in a sunny green park.
2. **Baking cookies:** your fox holding a tray of fresh cookies in a cozy kitchen, with a mixing bowl on the counter.
3. **Reading under a tree:** your fox sitting on the grass against a big leafy tree, reading a book.

Each prompt tells the editor to keep your fox's look and outfit and the flat cartoon style. The pictures will be square, with no text.
